title: Fix leafnode reconnect stall after compressed write timeout
body:
After a partial write, the pending count includes both leftover compressed data and new data waiting to be compressed. The compression code subtracted that entire count when replacing the new data with its compressed form, losing track of the leftovers. This could cause the write counts to go negative, which would stall the connection.

This should address some of what is reported in #7615 where the leafnodes would not reconnect.
